hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; blocked=false; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*) blocked=true;; esac; case "$cmd" in *"--dry-run"*) blocked=false;; esac; if $blocked; then branch=$(git -C /Users/scray/dev/projects/limen rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo "Refusing to git commit/push on main — create a feature branch first: git checkout -b <name>" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; }
